verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own documentation lists TPM-backed full-disk encryption, with guides to configure it and to recover data from it, so the product ships the capability itself. The evidence consists only of topic titles, though, and frames encryption as something the user sets up rather than something enabled automatically by default. missing for 10: evidence that encryption is on by default or applied automatically during install, details on how much setup the user must do, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I get full-disk encryption enabled automatically without manual security setup

citations.quote: Encrypt your disk with TPM ... Configure hardware-backed disk encryption ... Recover data from hardware-backed disk encryption
